maria: opened PR to clarify Nebula3b card around long-context and embedding sharding. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6012
jin: quick skim looks good. two small items: add `import numpy as np` in the snippet and prefer `max_new_tokens` over `max_tokens`.
ryan: also please normalize bench labels to 'tokens/sec' and annotate which variant (fp16 / q4) each row uses.
sam: on shard example, add a one-liner recommending the SDK batch helper before manual sharding. we should discourage naive averaging for retrieval without a note.
maria: will update. proposed compact snippet for SDK3 to drop in:
```python
import numpy as np
from redwood import Client
cli = Client()
# preferred: batch helper
embs = cli.batch([long_doc]).embed(model="nebula3b-embed")
# manual shard (appendix)
shards = [long_doc[i:i+1000] for i in range(0, len(long_doc), 1000)]
shard_embs = [cli.embed(model="nebula3b-embed", text=s) for s in shards]
merged = np.mean(shard_embs, axis=0)
resp = cli.generate(model="nebula3b", prompt=long_doc, max_new_tokens=256, rolling_window=1024)
```
